AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JANUARY 25, 2023
  UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
 ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS PLANNING COMMISSION MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A
 REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
 MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: planning@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN
 THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING 1-(669) 444-9171 OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 929 283
  6465# DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS
CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-
  hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  AND VIA VIDEO/TELECONFERENCE
  Rosa Barragan, Chair
  Linda Lopez, Vice Chair
  Kim Apodaca, Planning Commissioner
  Gabriel P. Garcia, Planning Commissioner
  Luis Navas, Planning Commissioner
 Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address Planning Commission on any matter listed on the agenda or on any
 other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal
 Code. If you wish to address Planning Commission, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to
 Council Chambers and hand the card to the Secretary. Planning Commission will hear public comment on items listed on
 the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. Planning Commission will hear public comment on matters
 not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule
 certain matters for consideration at a future Planning Commission meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Planning Commission:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the Planning Commission as a whole and not directed to individual Planning
  Commission members.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the Secretary's office, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda
 after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e?mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 Notice of Special Meeting

CALL TO ORDER

FLAG SALUTE Commissioner Garcia

ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS

  1.  MEETING MINUTES - Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes of the
  Special Meeting of January 11, 2023.

  Minutes of 1-11-23

  CONTNUED PUBLIC HEARING

  2. ZONE CHANGE (ZC) NO. 362
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP) NO. 1029
  PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN (PDP) NO. 2043
  Andrew Dewar, Shapell Properties, Inc. ("Applicant"); a request to redevelop an 8.06-acre property
  into a mixed-use development composed of 209-dwelling units including 3,056 square feet of flex
  commercial space fronting Alondra Boulevard. The subject property is generally known as 11600
  Alondra Boulevard, located on the southeast corner of Alondra Boulevard and Maidstone Avenue
  (also known as Assessor’s Parcel Number ("APN") 7014-001-002), in the Restricted Commercial (C-1)
  and Automobile Parking (P) zone. The project includes a request for:

  (1) ZC: - To amend the zoning designation of portions of the site zoned Automobile Parking (P)
  to Restricted Commercial (C-1);

  (2) CUP - To permit a mixed-use development in the C-1 zone; and

  (3) PDP - To permit the construction of a three-story mixed-use development consisting of 209
  dwelling units, 3,056 square feet of commercial flex space, and associated site improvements.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission continue the public hearing of Zone
  Change No. 362, Conditional Use Permit No. 1029 and Precise Development Plan No. 2043 to the
  meeting of February 8. 2023.

  Staff Report - ZC362 CUP1029 PDP2043

  Recommendation Page

PUBLIC HEARING

  3.  SIXTH CYCLE (2021-2029) HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE
  General Plan Amendment (GPA) No. 183
  A request to update the Housing Element of the General Plan for the sixth cycle (2021-2029)
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 23-04, recommending
  City Council approval of General Plan Amendment No. 183.

  Staff Report - Housing Element Update

  Attachment A - Resolution 23-04

  Attachment B - Draft Housing Element w/Appendix A & B

  Attachment C - Letter from HCD

  Attachment D - Staff Recommendation

4.  ITEMS FROM STAFF (Oral Report)

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT
 I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated January 19, 2023.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Director of Community Development/Secretary

 CALL TO ORDER  6:00 P.M.
FLAG SALUTE  Commissioner Navas
ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS  Commissioner Apodaca, Commissioner Garcia, Commissioner
  Navas, Vice Chair Lopez and Chair Barragan

1. MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve the minutes
  of the Special Meeting of January 11, 2023.
  Planning Commission Action: Approved.

CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING

2. ZONE CHANGE (ZC) NO. 362
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP) NO. 1029
  PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN (PDP) NO. 2043
  Andrew Dewar, Shapell Properties, Inc. (“Applicant”); a request to redevelop an 8.06-acre
  property into a mixed-use development composed of 209-dwelling units including 3,056 square
  feet of flex commercial space fronting Alondra Boulevard. The subject property is generally
  known as 11600 Alondra Boulevard, located on the southeast corner of Alondra Boulevard and
  Maidstone Avenue (also known as Assessor’s Parcel Number (“APN”) 7014-001-002), in the
  Restricted Commercial (C-1) and Automobile Parking (P) zone. The project includes a request
  for:
  (1) ZC: To amend the zoning designation of portions of the site zoned Automobile Parking
  (P) to Restricted Commercial (C-1);
  (2) CUP - To permit a mixed-use development in the C-1 zone; and
  (3) PDP - To permit the construction of a three-story mixed-use development consisting of 209
  dwelling units, 3,056 square feet of commercial flex space, and associated site
  improvements.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission continue the public hearing of Zone
  Change No. 362, Conditional Use Permit No. 1029 and Precise Development Plan No. 2043
  to the meeting of February 8, 2023.
  Planning Commission Action: Approved staff’s recommendation by a vote of 5-0.

PUBLIC HEARING

3. SIXTH CYCLE (2021-2029) HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE
  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT (GPA) NO. 183
  A request to update the Housing Element of the General Plan for the sixth cycle (2021-2029)
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 23-04,
  recommending City Council approval of General Plan Amendment No. 183.
  Planning Commission Action: Approved staff’s recommendation by a vote of 5-0.

4. ITEMS FROM STAFF (Oral Report)
  Jill Ann Arabe, Development Services Manager, presented an update of projects submitted and
  under review. Commissioner Navas commented on the continued lack of enforcement of box
  signs, and he requested that licenses for alcohol be brought back for review by the Planning
  Commission.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - None

ADJOURNMENT  6:50 P.M.
